invariants.rationale: tmxFile is used to compute the atlasHandle and as a parameter to loadTiledMap, so it must be non-null to prevent exceptions.
manager is passed to the AssetManagerAtlasResolver constructor; it must not be null to construct the resolver.
parameter may be nullable, as it is passed directly to loadTiledMap, suggesting its possible nullness is supported.
fileName is typically expected to be a valid string representing a file name; in practical use it should be non-null.
